instruction: A candid medium-shot documentary photograph of a bright indoor workshop. On the right, the young man with dark curly hair in a plaid flannel shirt (R1) stands holding a white smartphone, looking down at the screen with a neutral expression. To his left, the young man with an afro in a grey shirt (R2) stands with his arms crossed, leaning in slightly to look at the phone screen. In the foreground, a wooden bird sculpture sits on a table. The scene is illuminated by bright, diffused indoor light, creating a clean and neutral color palette.
